title: PC-02: a smallest stable remnant halts black-hole evaporation

statements.text: A smallest stable remnant halts black-hole evaporation.
statements.scope: a prediction candidate, not a frozen prediction row
statements.conditions: Where it stands: E-GRV-0051 finds a remnant at mass $1/(4\omega_{\max})$, but from the cutoff of the coined walk, which is imported (R-FND-0001). A lone vibe's motion under the one-third turn, apart from the committed knit, is measured (E-QTM-0103) and could replace the walk's cutoff. What it needs: a remnant mass derived from the committed knit, and an observable that bounds it.

standing.reason: a candidate: it has not passed the prediction gate
